title: Orunmila quarantined record, schema version 1
description: One input that reached intake for this session and was not a valid mark, kept whole with the reasons it was refused, one line of the quarantine log after its header. Redaction runs before anything is kept, so a secret in a malformed input is removed here as in a mark.
$comment: brief v4 lines 340-341 and test 28 name no fields: every field name here is the agent's choice. Written by src/opon/ledger/session-log.js. Unknown fields are allowed (LD17).

record.description: Marks this line as a quarantined input.

session_id.description: The session whose log this is, as in its header.

seq.description: This record's place in the quarantine log's own chain, from 1; it counts separately from the raw log's seq.

received_at.description: Wall-clock time intake received the input, in UTC.
received_at.$comment: agent's choice; the form of a mark's observed_at

reasons.description: Why the input is not a valid mark, one sentence each (for example a schema rule it breaks, or that it is not JSON). Never empty.
reasons.$comment: brief v4 line 341 (kept with its reasons); agent's choice

received.description: The input as received, after redaction: its JSON text when it was JSON, otherwise its text as it came.
received.$comment: brief v4 line 340 (nothing dropped); agent's choice

redactions.description: The kinds of secret redaction removed from the input (for example `aws_access_key`), never their values; absent when none.
redactions.$comment: brief v4 line 248; agent's choice, as a mark's detail.redactions

kept.description: Files that came with the input and were kept beside the log anyway, each named `sha256:` and its 64 hex digits, as a mark's diff_ref; absent when none.
kept.$comment: agent's choice, LD59 (evidence is never dropped)

prev_hash.description: The previous line's hash in the quarantine log (the header's, for the first record).
